page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v5 is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is driven by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz, offering 10 physical cores configured with simultaneous multithreading to deliver 20 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 260 MB of L3 cache, complemented by support for instruction sets including AVX-512, AES, and SHA-NI. The instance is provisioned with 160 GB of RAM, allocating 8 GB per vCPU.

For local I/O operations, the instance bundles 805 GB of local SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The configuration contains no dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on CPU execution for mathematical and machine learning routines. Networking capabilities do not provision complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring virtual network or gateway assignment for external access.

Benchmark assessments demonstrate standout memory throughput, highlighted by a PassMark memory score of 2776.57 placed in the top quartile of tested systems. Memory bandwidth benchmarks yield 1042.48 GB/sec on cached 16 KB read blocks and 117.04 GB/sec on uncached 256 MB reads, supporting 19.85 million Redis SET operations per second. General compute metrics show mid-tier results, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 11082 and a PassMark CPU score of 25791.42. Machine learning evaluations show strong throughput for lightweight 135M model generation at 269.68 tokens per second, but steep performance degradation on 70B parameter models at 4.19 tokens per second for prompt processing, demonstrating architectural constraints for massive AI model processing without discrete accelerators.

The instance provides high memory density per compute core, making it a cost-efficient platform for workloads constrained primarily by memory capacity and memory subsystem latency rather than brute-force vector compute. Best-fit deployments include relational database management systems, in-memory caching solutions like Redis, mid-tier enterprise software, and memory-bound ETL data pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 2.8 GHz 10-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor delivering 20 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 160 GB of system RAM, it maintains an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-heavy operations. The instance includes 805 GB of local SSD storage alongside premium storage capability, with no integrated hardware GPUs. Hardware acceleration features include AVX-512 and cryptographic extensions. In performance testing, the instance achieves strong memory performance with PassMark memory scoring in the top quartile and uncached read bandwidth reaching 117.04 GB/sec. General compute benchmarks reflect consistent mid-tier performance across multi-core tests and web serving throughput of 25.24 GB/sec, while CPU-bound large model inference reveals execution limits. The server delivers cost-effective resource density for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, enterprise relational database management systems, and intensive data processing tasks.
